items.title: Lufthansa’s 1st A350-1000 Unveiled (With Striking 100 Years Livery!)
items.summary: On July 14th Lufthansa unveiled its first Airbus A350-1000, the largest twin-engine aircraft ever to join the airline's fleet. The aircraft is notable not only because it introduces a new flagship widebody, but also because it represents the 700th Airbus aircraft delivered to the Lufthansa Group.

items.title: Airbus delivers first NH90 designed for special operations to France
items.summary: Airbus Helicopters has officially delivered the first NH90 Standard 2 to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA).
